note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS New Testament wording and the 1962-register Old Testament the first edition carried.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse or passage, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…' where Cyprian abridges; verbatim recitations without quote marks count. Psalm references use the Hebrew numbering; the prose keeps Cyprian's own (LXX) Psalm numbers.

Cyprian quotes an Old Latin text. Where his argument or a Testimonies heading rests on a reading OWB lacks (e.g. Isa 7:14 'virgin', Ps 116:15 'precious', Prov 16:6 / Dan 4:27 on almsgiving, Matt 6:11 'daily bread', Matt 6:13 'suffer us not', 1 John 5:7, Hab 2:4 'by my faith'), the quotation is rendered from his English and the row is `self_rendered` with a `why`. The deuterocanonical books (Sirach, Wisdom, Tobit, Baruch, Maccabees, the additions to Daniel) have no OWB text and keep the translator's rendering, also `self_rendered`.
